n25e223fab3.headline: AfDB Withdraws K52.7 Billion as Malawi Faces Mounting Donor Compliance Concerns | Nyasa Times
n25e223fab3.summary: Malawi has lost about K52.705 billion in African Development Bank funding after the institution revised its African Development Fund downward. Donor compliance concerns are mounting.
n25e223fab3.why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender, and reductions in its concessional funding affect public investment and budget planning in member countries.

source.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

sources.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

n87dc82007d.headline: EU Tells Members To Prepare For Prolonged
n87dc82007d.summary: The EU has told member states to prepare for a prolonged period of disruption, with Iran sanctions, blockades and their impact on crude oil markets and shipping routes ongoing.
n87dc82007d.why: The EU sets trade and sanctions policy across its member states, and disruptions to crude shipping routes affect global energy prices and supply chains.

ne4e20fc682.headline: Kenya Shields Fuel Supply, Prices With G-to-G Deal Amid Iran War
ne4e20fc682.summary: The government credits its Government-to-Government import deal with keeping fuel supply stable and cushioning the country from global oil price volatility linked to Middle East tensions.
ne4e20fc682.why: Fuel import costs affect inflation, transport prices and fiscal pressure in import-dependent economies such as Kenya.

n2e4ea90b8b.headline: Kenya: Ruto Mandates Inter-Ministerial Response to Avert Fuel Stockouts
n2e4ea90b8b.summary: President William Ruto said the government is closely monitoring global oil markets and is ready to introduce measures to cushion the economy from shocks linked to Middle East tensions.
n2e4ea90b8b.why: Kenya imports most of its refined fuel, so supply disruptions and price spikes directly affect transport costs and inflation.

n9785877406.headline: Mozambique Saves 20 Million Dollars On Exports to China
n9785877406.summary: Mozambique saves about 20 million US dollars annually on its exports to China, the result of China's zero-tariff policy applied to its goods.
n9785877406.why: Tariff access to large import markets such as China shapes export earnings for developing economies. Preferential duties affect trade balances and foreign currency inflows.

nd8e69c8844.headline: Fuel pain to last longer despite tax cut kicking in
nd8e69c8844.summary: Fuel prices will not immediately fall at the bowser when a tax cut comes into effect, and may remain elevated for longer.
nd8e69c8844.why: Fuel excise changes shift the retail price of petrol and diesel, influencing inflation and household budgets. Wholesale crude and refining margins also drive pump prices.

n5477ce7793.headline: Obesity drug developer Kailera Therapeutics sets sights on IPO
n5477ce7793.summary: Kailera Therapeutics is planning to go public as it seeks additional funding to advance its obesity drug pipeline through clinical trials.
n5477ce7793.why: Biotech IPOs raise capital for clinical development and test investor appetite for the obesity drug sector, which is a major pharmaceutical growth area.

n72ac8fb400.headline: Cafes, hotels take swipe at $1.6b consumer card fee win
n72ac8fb400.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia has removed surcharges on debit and credit card transactions, which it says will save consumers $1.6 billion. Cafes and hotels have criticised the decision.
n72ac8fb400.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets monetary and payments policy, and card surcharge rules directly affect merchant revenues and payment networks.

n45456bf229.headline: Full tank of diesel breaks £100 mark as Iran oil crisis deepens
n45456bf229.summary: Average UK forecourt diesel prices reached 182.8p per litre on Tuesday, so a full tank now costs more than £100. The rise comes as the Iran oil crisis deepens.
n45456bf229.why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs, inflation and household budgets, and they track global crude markets.

ncf36ac774e.headline: Malaga housing: prices in Teatinos district start resembling those in high-cost Este district
ncf36ac774e.summary: Price per square metre in Malaga's Teatinos district is approaching levels seen in the costlier Este district. Prices in the Costa del Sol capital have risen more than 10% on average for eleven consecutive years.
ncf36ac774e.why: Housing prices affect mortgage lending, construction activity and household wealth, which matter to property investors and Spanish banks.

nceb0db76eb.headline: Trump's dig at UK over defending Strait of Hormuz as he says US 'won't help'
nceb0db76eb.summary: US President Donald Trump said countries such as the UK should secure the Strait of Hormuz themselves and that the US would not be there to help anymore.
nceb0db76eb.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so security arrangements there directly affect energy supply and prices.

nc142311eda.headline: South Africa: Parliament Must Urgently Convene to Discuss the Fuel Crisis As a Matter of National Importance
nc142311eda.summary: Fuel prices are likely to rise by over R5 a litre for petrol and R10 for diesel. Parliament is winding down its term with no sittings scheduled before the price increase on 1 April.
nc142311eda.why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs and inflation across the South African economy, affecting consumers and businesses.

nc878ca3107.headline: Indian GDP May Take A Hit Of 1% Point If War Continues In FY27, Anticipates EY Report
nc878ca3107.summary: An EY Economy Watch report says India's economy may take a hit of up to 1 percentage point in FY27 if the West Asian war continues. Retail inflation could rise by an extra 1.5 points.
nc878ca3107.why: India is a large oil importer, so prolonged Middle East conflict feeds into inflation, the current account and growth. Forecasts like this influence expectations for Reserve Bank of India policy and Indian equities.

n7e4080d5fa.headline: Thailand's GPF pivots to emerging market debt as capex scrutiny intensifies | Alternatives
n7e4080d5fa.summary: Thailand's Government Pension Fund is pivoting toward emerging market debt. Its chief investment officer discussed external manager alignment and scrutiny of corporate capital expenditure.
n7e4080d5fa.why: Thailand's Government Pension Fund is one of the country's largest institutional investors, so its allocation shifts influence local and global bond demand.

neffb067b2e.headline: US Secretary of State criticises Spain for vetoing use of military bases and airspace
neffb067b2e.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio criticised Spain for vetoing US use of military bases and airspace. He said NATO loses its purpose if the US cannot use the bases when needed.
neffb067b2e.why: Spain hosts US military facilities, and disputes over base access affect NATO cohesion and defence and security planning.

n375c64bcb3.headline: Taiwan: Powering Ahead
n375c64bcb3.summary: Taiwan's booming economy is expected to keep growing, but heavy reliance on semiconductor exports is prompting concern among analysts, according to Global Finance.
n375c64bcb3.why: Taiwan hosts leading chipmakers such as TSMC, so its export performance is closely watched by investors in global semiconductors.

n46a2b66303.headline: West Asia war can shave off 1 pc point from India's GDP growth projections: EY
n46a2b66303.summary: EY says a prolonged Middle East conflict could cut about 1 percentage point from India's GDP growth. It also estimates retail inflation could rise by 1.5 percentage points next fiscal year.
n46a2b66303.why: Growth and inflation forecasts shape expectations for interest rates, corporate earnings and the rupee.

n326a13c3b8.headline: China Confirms Three Ships Passed Through Strait
n326a13c3b8.summary: China confirmed that three ships passed through the Strait of Hormuz amid a crisis affecting global oil flows and tanker operations. Coverage tracks the impact on shipping.
n326a13c3b8.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruptions there directly affect crude prices and shipping costs. Tanker traffic is a key indicator of supply security.
n326a13c3b8.why_moved: The crisis around the Strait of Hormuz is affecting global oil flows and tanker operations, which is the kind of supply disruption that moves crude prices.

n33204aa9f3.headline: Euro Falls on Rate Expectations
n33204aa9f3.summary: The dollar ends March with its best monthly performance since September 2022, while the euro posts its worst quarter since 2024, with Brent above $105 per barrel.
n33204aa9f3.why: The euro is the currency of the euro area, and its value against the dollar affects European importers, exporters and inflation expectations. Oil prices feed directly into those dynamics.

impacts.name: Euro
impacts.why: Investor concerns about the global economy and rate expectations have pushed the euro lower against the dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n33204aa9f3.why_moved: Investor concerns about the global economy and a Middle East conflict that pushed Brent above $105 per barrel shifted flows toward the dollar. The supply shock raises slowdown risks for the euro area.

nd81efed36f.headline: Southeast Asia’s Energy Emergency Begins
nd81efed36f.summary: The Philippines has seen one of the world's sharpest increases in petrol prices, according to Foreign Policy's report on Southeast Asia's energy emergency. The Philippines is among the countries most exposed to the price surge.
nd81efed36f.why: The Philippines imports most of its oil, so global crude price moves pass quickly into domestic fuel prices and inflation.

n9d522ef514.headline: Taxpayers stung for Defence mistake on Redback vehicles
n9d522ef514.summary: Defence's failure to pay invoices on time for a project worth $7 billion will cost taxpayers hundreds of millions, according to the report.
n9d522ef514.why: Defence procurement is a large public spending area, and payment delays on major contracts can raise costs for government and suppliers.

nf28cfb7190.headline: No immediate need for broad stimulus package, says Bank Negara
nf28cfb7190.summary: Bank Negara Malaysia said there is no immediate need for a broad stimulus package. Any government support must be targeted and based on a fuller assessment of the Middle East conflict's economic fallout.
nf28cfb7190.why: Bank Negara is Malaysia's central bank, and its policy views shape expectations for interest rates and fiscal support. Targeted versus broad stimulus choices affect domestic growth and inflation outlooks.

n27254290a1.headline: Inflation to slower growth, West Asia shock to shape global economy in various ways: IMF
n27254290a1.summary: The International Monetary Fund said the ongoing US-Israel and Iran war could shape the global economy in different ways, including through inflation and slower growth.
n27254290a1.why: The IMF is the global lender that publishes the World Economic Outlook, a benchmark for growth and inflation forecasts used by investors and policymakers.

nb9c648c5e5.headline: China PMIs Return to Expansion as Output and Orders Rebound, but Cost Pressures Surge
nb9c648c5e5.summary: China's manufacturing PMI rose to 50.4 in March, back into expansion as orders and output improved. Input costs rose sharply over the same period.
nb9c648c5e5.why: The PMI is a closely watched gauge of China's factory activity, and China is the world's largest manufacturer and a major commodity importer.

n5935f98fd9.headline: Uber and WeRide ramp up robotaxi operations in Dubai
n5935f98fd9.summary: Uber and WeRide have launched robotaxi operations without a human safety operator in Dubai, as part of a broader expansion in the Middle East.
n5935f98fd9.why: Uber is a global ride-hailing platform, and WeRide develops autonomous driving technology. Commercial robotaxi deployments are a key test of the business case for self-driving services.

n5bab095cb9.headline: Gas crosses $4 a gallon in the U.S. for the first time in 3 years
n5bab095cb9.summary: Gas prices in the US have crossed $4 a gallon for the first time in three years, driven up by the war with Iran at a time when affordability is a major concern.
n5bab095cb9.why: Gasoline prices feed directly into US consumer spending and inflation expectations. They are closely tied to crude oil prices and refining margins.

n2ce8d08f05.headline: The Latest: Iran strikes fully loaded oil tanker off Dubai coast as gas reaches $4 a gallon in US
n2ce8d08f05.summary: Dubai authorities said they contained a fully loaded Kuwaiti oil tanker after it came under Iranian attack. Officials reported no oil leakage and no injuries.
n2ce8d08f05.why: Attacks on tankers in the Gulf threaten oil shipments through key chokepoints, which can lift crude prices and shipping insurance costs.
n2ce8d08f05.why_moved: An Iranian attack on a fully loaded oil tanker off Dubai raises concerns about disruption to Gulf oil shipments.

ndb79ffe6db.headline: Whoop's valuation just tripled to $10 billion
ndb79ffe6db.summary: The fitness tracking startup closed a $575 million Series G round, with Cristiano Ronaldo and LeBron James among its investors, tripling its valuation to $10 billion.
ndb79ffe6db.why: Late-stage private funding rounds set valuation benchmarks for consumer health-tech and signal investor appetite ahead of possible public listings.

n7c10bd771c.headline: Japan, France agree rare earths deal to cut China reliance, NHK reports
n7c10bd771c.summary: Japan and France agreed to strengthen support for rare earths supply chains, NHK reported, in moves to lessen dependence on China.
n7c10bd771c.why: Rare earths are critical inputs for magnets used in electric vehicles, defence and electronics, and China dominates their processing.

n45c2b42255.headline: Sanu Gold Corp.: Sanu Gold Confirms 8km Gold Corridor at Daina 1 on Multiple Parallel Structures, in Guinea, West Africa
n45c2b42255.summary: Sanu Gold Corporation reported discovery of an 8-kilometer gold corridor at its Daina 1 project in Guinea, West Africa.
n45c2b42255.why: Exploration success in gold-rich Guinea can enhance the company’s valuation and impact regional mining investment.

n358fbfe7d5.headline: Seabridge Gold Inc.: Seabridge Gold Provides Updated Mineral Resource Estimates for KSM Project
n358fbfe7d5.summary: Seabridge Gold announced updated mineral resource estimates for its KSM gold project in northwestern Canada.
n358fbfe7d5.why: KSM is one of the largest undeveloped gold projects globally; resource updates affect project valuation and mining sector investment.
